title: Français 5581 — Letter from Mondesir
contents: A private letter from Isle de France criticizes the governor’s conduct, weak coastal defence and food shortages caused by price controls. The writer also discusses an artillery appointment, the forge enterprise, debts, and selling his share to provide for his wife.
fields: Writer in Mondesir, Isle de France (name not established)
24 mapped signs: 23 letter forms, 1 name; 2 personal signs unidentified.

excerpt: même **de son metier**, aussi est on, on peu dire, **ignorant presomptueux, entete** comme un **bas Breton** qu’on est **[?] se lai[s]se prevenir** fortement souvent par le premier **venu, entier** dans ses **idees** qu'on a saisit promptement et mis **à execution** sans **faire** aucune **reflexion ni consulter** personne. Aussi fait on beaucoup **de sottises et d'ordonnances** dont on est obligé **de revenir ou** de laisser sans effets. **[?] est vif** jusque à **l’emportement** et aux **exces**…
translation: Even in his own profession, he is, one may say, ignorant, presumptuous, and stubborn as a Breton. [?] lets himself be strongly prejudiced by the first person who comes along, clings to ideas hastily seized upon, and puts them into action without reflection or consulting anyone. This produces many foolish decisions and orders that have to be reversed or left without effect. [?] is impetuous, to the point of anger and excess.

excerpt: **la deffence sur l’agiotage des billets du Roy** avec **les piastres**, sur lequel on a esté obligé de fermer les yeux comme sur **la taxation des denrees** de toute espece.
translation: The ban on speculating in the king’s bills against piastres, on which they have been obliged to turn a blind eye, as with fixing the prices of provisions of every kind.

excerpt: Et si après on veut **maccorder des hommes et de largent** et que jaye **deux ans de paix** pour me **preparer a la guerre** on verra la Différence **du[c/n?] homme e un autre**.
translation: And if they then wish to give me men and money, and I have two years of peace to prepare for war, people will see the difference between [one?] man and another.
